about_the_game:
The demo showcases the game's core gameplay mechanics, including exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving. Players must navigate through dense foliage, overcome obstacles, and solve environmental puzzles to progress further into the island's interior.

Throughout the demo, players catch glimpses of the island's dark history and the sinister forces at play behind the virus outbreak. Cryptic messages and hidden clues hint at a larger conspiracy waiting to be unraveled.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8 or 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz Intel
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 compatible or better.

short_description: Shrouded Mind: pits scientist Kaiser Manger and US Marshal Andre Kar against a deadly virus turning islanders into berserk maniacs. Racing against time, they must find a cure while battling through perilous jungles and uncovering a sinister conspiracy. Will they save the island before it's too late?
